title: API Proposal: instansearch instance events to indicate the DOM is ready
body:
## The problem

When doing the rendering of all the components we see different manipulations of the dom until the initial search is done. This makes the display flickers and doesn't provide a very polished effect.

## Some thoughts

We could have the components to only display themselves when they are ready to be used (eg : after init for the search input, or after the rendering after the first search for the hits). Because we chose to keep our rendering to the minimum some elements will be displayed that are depending on the integration, therefore we should make it possible to listen to the lifecycle of the instantsearch.js (who said events ;) )

## API proposal

basically the instantsearch.js instance would be an event emitter with two events for the moment  :

* `render` which will be triggered after the each rendering of all the widgets that implement `render`
